Paris Hilton lobbies US Congress for DEFIANCE Act against deepfakes

Paris Hilton visited Capitol Hill to advocate for the passage of the DEFIANCE Act, a bipartisan bill aimed at combating sexually explicit deepfake images. She stated that the abuse she has faced has not stopped and urged the US Congress to pass the legislation. The bill seeks to provide legal recourse against the creation and distribution of non-consensual explicit deepfakes.
